known_limitations: ComponentReference, ArchitectureDecisionReference, Limitation, and RecommendedTask ORM mappings remain absent.
No Domain/ORM mapper, migration, schema/table creation, live PostgreSQL, production Repository, Session, Unit of Work, transaction, Parser/Indexer, API, or UI exists.
The database mapping cannot enforce path or URI safety, secret scanning, exact replay, append authorization, immutable-content equality, or atomic batches.
Static DDL compilation used an existing SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 environment while production requirements pin 2.0.25.
Context and Manifest schema v1 cannot encode exact next task QM2-P0-002A2a2b in machine recommended-task arrays, so legal parents QM2-P0-002 and QM2-P0-002A2 are used there.
The containing commit cannot be embedded self-referentially; Git history resolves it after commit.
